Test Description: Verify reset defaults and masked write-read behavior of PCIe DBI DSP registers for port 0. The test checks default values and validates write-read results using masks and predefined patterns.
Remarks: Some registers are not readable or writable. Certain registers are excluded from default checks. Debug messages are optional. A soft reset helper exists but is not executed. Six data patterns are used.
Test Steps / Procedure:
1) Read each readable DBI DSP register and compare with its reset default; exclude the predefined exception registers.
2) For each of six data patterns, write to each writable DBI DSP register that is not flagged to skip.
3) Read back from readable and writable DBI DSP registers and compute the expected value using masks and defaults; compare with the read value.
4) After all iterations, declare pass only if both default and write-read mismatch counters are zero; otherwise declare fail.
Validation / Acceptance Criteria:
1) Default check value equals the reset default → Pass
2) Masked write-read value equals the computed expected value → Pass
3) No default mismatches and no write-read mismatches at end of test → Pass
